inventory_size.summary: How many slots an inventory has.
params: an entity carrying it, or the position of a block containing one
inventory_size.returns: `num` — the number of slots, `null` when there is no inventory there.

inventory_get.summary: The content of a slot, or of the whole inventory.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: which slot; without it, all of them
inventory_get.returns: `list` — the item as `[name, count, nbt]`, or the list of every slot; `null` when the slot is empty.
examples:
// counting what is in a chest
list.reduce(item.inventory_get(chest_pos), _a + (_ == null ? 0 : _:1), 0);

inventory_set.summary: Writes a slot of an inventory.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: the item to put there; without it, only the count changes
optional: the data of the item
inventory_set.returns: `list` — what was in the slot before.

inventory_find.summary: The first slot holding a given item.
params: the entity or the position holding it
the item to look for; `null` finds the first empty slot
inventory_find.returns: `num` — the slot, `null` when there is none.
examples: item.inventory_find(player, null);            // the first free slot

inventory_remove.summary: Takes items out of an inventory, wherever they are in it.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: how many, one by default
inventory_remove.returns: `bool` — `true` when everything asked for was taken out.
inventory_remove.note: It is all or nothing: with fewer than `count` in the inventory it removes nothing and answers `false`.

inventory_has_items.summary: Whether the inventory holds everything asked for.
params: the entity or the position holding it
the items, as names or as `[name, count]` pairs
inventory_has_items.returns: `bool` — whether all of them are there.

drop_item.summary: Throws the content of a slot on the ground.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: how many; without it, everything

item_list.summary: Every item the game knows, or the ones carrying a tag.
params: optional: only the items of that tag

item_tags.summary: The tags of an item, or whether it carries one of them.
item_tags.returns: `list` of tags, or `bool` when a tag is given.

item_category.summary: The tab of the creative menu the item lives in.
item_category.returns: `str` — the name of the category, `null` when it is in none.

stack_limit.returns: `num` — the maximum size of a stack.

crafting_remaining_item.summary: What is left in the grid after using that item in a recipe.
crafting_remaining_item.returns: `str` — the name of what remains, `null` when nothing does.

item_display_name.summary: The name of the item as the game shows it, translated.
params: the item, as a name or as a triple

recipe_data.summary: The recipes producing an item: ingredients, result and kind.
recipe_data.returns: `list` — one entry per recipe, `null` when there is none.

item_components.summary: Every data component of an item, as a map from id to value.
params: optional: with `true` it reads the components the **kind of item** has, not the ones this stack carries
item_components.returns: `map` — from component id to its value.
item_components.note: Since 1.20.5 an item is an id plus typed components, not free-form NBT. Reading through the raw NBT still works for what is in the NBT, but it cannot tell an absent value from one equal to the default.

item_component.summary: A single data component of an item.
params: the id of the component, as `'minecraft:damage'`
optional: with `true` it reads the value of the kind of item
item_component.returns: the value of the component, `null` when the stack does not carry it.

set_item_component.summary: The item with one component changed, or removed when the value is `null`.
params: the new value; `null` removes the component
set_item_component.returns: `list` — a **copy** of the item with the change; the original is untouched.
set_item_component.note: A value that makes no sense for that component is refused right away by the codec, with a `TypeMismatchError` — the alternative is a broken item discovered much later, when somebody tries to use it.

component_list.summary: The ids of every data component this game knows.
